rows.behaviorContract: A Haskell-owned deterministic generator builds a temporary 12,000-commit/2,000-operation repository from the owned large-stress plan. The explicit executable gate is pending a completed isolated full-run baseline for cold compile, cache, search, relevance, and branch-isolation assertions.

evidence.fixture: test/e2e/Adrai/LargeRepositoryStressTest.hs (Haskell-owned fast-import generator; it does not execute the Python prototype)
evidence.result: 2026-08-24 partial exact-gate evidence: initial fresh Haskell materialization completed in 26,014 ms; cold compile completed in 10,761 ms under +RTS -N1 -M2G with max_bytes_used=58,678,704 bytes and POSIX complete process-tree peak=143,155,200 bytes across 6 successful samples. Post-G.6 rerun at HEAD d776eae: fresh Haskell materialization completed in 25,352 ms; cold compile completed in 11,324 ms under +RTS -N1 -M2G with max_bytes_used=58,906,232 bytes and Windows complete process-tree peak=144,482,304 bytes across 6 successful samples. Cold counters passed: errors=0, cache_mode=full, incremental_kind=full, history_commits_scanned=12,000, documents_parsed=5,350, adrs_rebuilt=900. The first immediate same-revision exact-cache assertion instead returned cache_mode=full and incremental_kind=full after 20,822 ms, so this remains a production cache-selection defect; retrieval/relevance/tree-identical/branch checks, ledger closure, audit, and scoped commit remain pending separate atomic remediation.
